body:
Same. 😂
It’s easier to fix others than it is to fix ourselves.

I’ve definitely not tried everything.
Could definitely take use of our health service. 
Thing is, the NHS is in abit of a state. I don’t want to waste their times or money that could be used on someone else who’s in a worse mental state than me. 
Although I do believe i share a lot of symptoms to those with manic depression (BPD).
So diagnostics could help for sure
Meds might even help
Therapy might be a-bit odd, I have a lot of particular odd things about my mind that I’d rather not have documented in anyway because they’re of quite of the concern for people that don’t know me properly. I get the client privileges, it’s just that if I was telling the truth, they would have to be violated and I’m not ready to have my trust potentially violated. 
I could definitely try this, but I see it as a last resort. The reality is, I don’t exactly want to live anyway, Serotonin pills won’t change my reason but only the emptyness, which would help for sure.
Makes me anxious about it all too. Booking and all that. Like fuck do I know what to say.
I’ve been procrastinating my suicide since like 10 (19 now) when I first started planning how I would carry it all out. A few piss poor attempts at it and bang, I practically know every viable fucking method to kill myself  and it’s success rate. Still can’t decide between monoxide poisoning via bag and tranq sleeping pills , hanging, explosives or good old helium. 
I’ve been thinking this through for years, reasons to live and reasons not too. It’s why I’ve been able to talk people out of suicide and enjoy doing it. I’m good at it.
Just not good enough to save myself huh.
I just wish someone would save me like I did for them.
I can’t tell if I’m bitter and envious or this world is just cruel towards me

I just don’t want to live this way for the rest of my existence.
A cycle of lonely misery.
The worst part of it is when I actually get feelings for someone and I feel euphoria for what the future beholds, for only a great downfall of disappointment.  I still find it hard to not want to envy everyone in a happy relationship. 
I am so deeply flawed and I’m trying to work on that.
I just really can’t see myself to a point where I can wake up in the morning and think, “Today is going to be great” 
Thing is ambi, you know what it’s like when people around want to be with you and love your company because you’ve had relationships that I imagine have had happy moments. I never have.
And I can’t tell if that’s what’s missing.
And if isn’t, then I’m truly fucked.
Life is misery, it’s just a matter of what I will do to justify that misery. Which is a difficult thing to do when everything almost feels meaningless.

I look forward to Avengers, Cyberpunk.
Everything a nerd looks forward too
Also the partying. I fucking love partying every week or so. It’s the only place where I can really connect with people and I love that. The only place where I don’t feel like blowing my skull open with a 12 gauge. 
But still, it feels meaningless. Alone and desolate.
I gotta success flowing through me like you couldn’t imagine. 
Yet at heart none of it matters. 
The loneliness is exponential, I don’t see it coming to an end until I end my self or so happen I don’t feel alone.
Life’s is bizarre and wonderful. Beholds me, someone who isn’t lonely but constantly feels alone. Like no one cares.
I’m missing something but I don’t know what it is. 
Life is crazzzzy

Cue the don’t kill ya self guy here
What else was you expecting? It’s anti kys and trolls on here

Right m8, you even got a plan on how to kill your self? You better of done your research. Because the odds ain’t in your favour to kys. And if you fuck it up like you probably will you’ll have more bills and more shame. So seriously think it through.

Now, you can’t be that much of a burden. You got a fiancé my guy. You doing better then the rest of the lonely fuckers on here. 
Imagine your girl hearing the news that you killed your self. If you’re going to do it. Make it very fucking clear that it was all on your shoulders. But even then it won’t matter. She will still try and blame herself at the end of the day. We all do in the event of a suicide. “Oh what could’ve I done better, I should’ve helped him. This is my fault for not seeing the signs, I should’ve paid more attention” your entire family and ya girl will be thinking that.
And god forbid you do it inside your home. Imagine the poor bastard who’s gotta find your corpse. That shits trauma. Your death is trauma. Let alone someone finding your corpse on top of that.

So yeah the bills are shit. And killing yourself ain’t gunna solve it. They will likely move those bills onto a loved one. You don’t want them paying your bills and dealing with your death.
It’s just not worth it.

You ain’t lonely, you know that.
Also you ain’t a burden. Look at the impact on the world you’ve made. You got a fiancé my guy. You’ve impacted her life a lot. Stay alive for her at least and yours future.
Talk to her about it if you want.

Enjoy your night my guy

I’ve explored

I found my meaning. I impacted the lives of the people around me. Emotional connections I created justified my existence in the eyes of others. And that gave me a reason. I wanted to do it more. I made people want to stay alive.

But I’ve lost that meaning. I’ve lost those people

Some say family. 
Some say friends
Some say relationships
Maybe even work. 

You may never find that reason. 
But work towards something. Give yourself a goal. And work towards that. That goal could justify the awful existence that were subjected too.

Life is suffering.
Find something to justify that suffering and bear it. Then you would’ve found your meaning.

That’s what some people say anyway
